benchmarks.label: Scout test bed SV3/t9
benchmarks.description: One 4-capability Scout test bed with 127 known plan-changing facts. Controlled experiments: compare only within one process version.
benchmarks.scoring: Facts kept in the final decisions, picked by id; verdicts compared with the reference model.

benchmarks.label: Planning wizard pilot 2
benchmarks.description: 12 planning documents; each stage extracts the obligations the plan places on the product (requirements, bans, checks, scope exclusions, conditions). The key is the 1,075 claims two blind judges agree on; the owner's sampled and disputed items are not settled yet, so quality numbers are preliminary.
benchmarks.scoring: Silent misses on judge-agreed obligations (lower is better), and model seconds per 1,000 words.
